variants.title: Sonometer: mass per unit length of a steel (music wire) wire, SWG 22
variants.sample: Steel (music wire) wire, SWG 22 (0.711 mm diameter)
variants.method: Resonance with tuning forks, μ = T / (4 l² f²)
variants.unknown: the linear mass density μ of the steel (music wire) wire
variants.note: μ = ρ π d² / 4 = 7850 x π x (0.711 mm)² / 4 = 3.117 g/m. With 4 kg on the hanger the 256 Hz fork resonates near l = 22 cm.

source.title: BS 3737 Standard Wire Gauge: SWG 22 = 0.711 mm
source.note: CRC Handbook / ASTM A228 music wire: density of carbon steel 7.85 g/cm3
